output_summary: Applied inversion lens: normal framing = more meetings, better tools, shared docs. Inversion = minimize collaboration, discover: forced independence surfaces hidden bottlenecks, context switches reveal true priorities, async reveals trust gaps. Synthesis: structured solo work followed by brief syncs captures both independence value and collaboration benefits.
test_notes: Lens successfully reframed the problem by examining its inverse, revealing that 'more collaboration' may not be the real goal. The inversion revealed hidden assumptions about what collaboration actually provides.
